blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — The Land Transportation Office (LTO) has issued a Show Cause Order (SCO) against the registered owner and designated driver of a vehicle involved in an alleged assault on a gasoline station attendant in Naga City, Cebu, after the driver reportedly punched the worker and repeatedly displayed a firearm during an argument. The agency also ordered the driver to surrender his driver’s license and placed the vehicle on alarm while its investigation into the incident continued.
